patterns.condition: An NPC should speak through an LLM persona
patterns.action: Attach a persona component to the NPC character definition and spawn it with an NPC spawner; behavior logic lives in a Verse npc_behavior
patterns.statement: Epic's template wires conversation this way

patterns.action: Create one character definition per persona; a definition carries only one persona
patterns.statement: Epic documents a one persona per definition limit

patterns.action: Check the experimental Persona Modifier and its constraints before design; features may change between releases
patterns.statement: Epic labels the persona modifier experimental

patterns.condition: Game state must change from what the NPC says
patterns.action: Define a struct with logic, int, float, enum or message fields, describe each field for the model, and register it as an action on the session
patterns.statement: Free text cannot be trusted to drive game state

patterns.condition: The model returns a value that affects score or price
patterns.action: Validate range and type in Verse before applying it; the template does not clamp numeric results
patterns.statement: Code review of the template found unchecked values

patterns.condition: A session ends or the NPC despawns
patterns.action: Cancel every subscription created for the session, including speech event subscriptions, not only the structured output ones
patterns.statement: The template cleans only the structured output actions

patterns.condition: Handlers fire while the NPC is still speaking
patterns.action: Set flags inside handlers and apply them at one stop-of-speech checkpoint, so game changes follow the spoken line
patterns.statement: Template reference loop applies flags when speech stops

patterns.condition: NPC is removed right after its last line
patterns.action: Wait a short moment, about one second, before despawn so the final audio is not cut
Handle the interrupted event explicitly instead of ignoring it, and decide whether the turn is lost or retried

patterns.condition: Players need to read what the NPC says
patterns.action: Drive captions from the commit and stop speech events through a UI manager and a widget, and hide them when speech stops

patterns.condition: Score or state is shown beside captions
patterns.action: Route score changes through the same UI manager so the widget and game state cannot diverge
patterns.statement: Single update path avoids cascading display errors

patterns.action: Voice chat is required and the language is English only; plan a fallback for players who cannot speak
patterns.statement: Epic lists these as current limits

patterns.action: LLM conversation is not supported on brand islands; keep a non-LLM path or build on a standard island
patterns.statement: Epic lists brand islands as unsupported

patterns.action: The session is not persistent; store anything that must survive in your own state and re-supply it as context next session
Latency and turn-taking are undocumented; measure them in your own playtests and add a timeout with a fallback line
patterns.statement: Gap in Epic documentation, kit guidance

patterns.condition: More than one player talks to one NPC
patterns.action: Multi-player limits are undocumented; test with two players early and serialize turns through one owner of the conversation
patterns.statement: Gap in Epic documentation, kit guidance
